items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And I think at that time, was it Fess Williams that was playing? [INTERVIEWEE] Fiddler Williams?

ctx.x: I’m not sure. I thought he just recommended that he be a part of it. That’s all I know.
And I think at that time, was it Fess Williams that was playing?
